programmes.d: Deborah Meaden and Theo Paphitis go head-to-head, aided by Mark Stacey and Thomas Plant.
It's day one for expert Thomas Plant and Road Trip newbie, Scottish auctioneer Paul Laidlaw, as they travel from Skipton to Sheffield.

Charlie Ross and Izzie Balmer continue their trip in Surrey. Izzie finds a piece of jewelry that causes a stir at auction. And Charlie's passion for furniture uncovers a very rare table that sparks a frenzy of bids at the Dorking auction.
Kirsty Wark and Alastair Stewart treasure hunt with Philip Serrell and Catherine Southon.
Day two for dynamic duo Thomas Plant and Paul Laidlaw sees them attempt to outwit each other on their way from Bolsover to the auction in Stamford.

In North Wessex Downs, Charlie Ross hunts for 'sparkly' antiques but is distracted by an Edwardian box that holds a surprise. And Izzie Balmer rummages in a shop's storeroom -- what goodies will she uncover?
It's charm versus mathematical prowess, as experts Thomas Plant and Paul Laidlaw hit the shops between Huntingdon and Towcester.
Tom Conti and Katie Derham fight it out with James Braxton and James Lewis.
A rare antique gets Charlie Ross quite excited while Izzie Balmer gambles on some furniture. Their classic car is pointed to the south coast for auction but who'll claim victory?
Thomas Plant and Paul Laidlaw's negotiating tactics are tested to the limit as they travel from Olney to the auction in Watlington.
Brian Blessed and Jenny Eclair take to the road with James Braxton and Anita Manning.
Izzie Balmer and Charlie Ross sail to the Isle of Wight for their final leg. Our experts go into auction battle one last time, when Izzie's silver brooch goes against Charlie's silver pen.
Thomas Plant and Paul Laidlaw spend their final day of antique adventuring heading from Tetsworth to the final auction showdown in Pewsey.
Phil Tufnell battles Chris Hollins, with Philip Serrell and Thomas Plant on hand.

Angus Ashworth and Steven Moore travel from the Borders to the Lake District. They encounter the story of the country's greatest archers and visit a part of Scotland that's slowly revealing its secrets to archaeologists.
It's Charlie Ross and Charles Hanson's first day together as they kick off their journey in Bridlington and head to an auction showdown in Doncaster.
Charlie Ross and Charles Hanson are getting on famously as they drive the second leg of their road trip from Scunthorpe to Grantham.

Steven Moore and Angus Ashworth are shopping their way along the byways of Scotland. Angus bags something aromatic and coffee related, while Steven springs for a little treasure from his fellow expert's back yard in Yorkshire.
Margie Cooper and Mark Hill, a yellow roadster and the Yorkshire moors.
The competition heats up on day three as the two Charlies journey from King's Lynn to the auction in Beccles.
While Angus Ashworth strips off for an unlikely history lesson, Steven Moore tucks into a local delicacy. Will a rough ferry crossing leave them feeling sick at the Clitheroe auction?
Will antique cosmetics out-profit a Victorian board game from Germany?
It's day four of Charlie Ross and Charles Hanson's road trip, heading from Lavenham in Suffolk to Greenwich--until their car breaks down.
Breakdowns, brisk weather and a macabre discovery that could be a sure thing at auction.

Steven Moore and Angus Ashworth hit the byways of Derbyshire and Yorkshire. They visit a couple of survivors from the Industrial Revolution and enjoy some regional pastries before heading off to an auction in the town of Bedale.
The fifth leg of the journey for Charles Hanson and Charlie Ross takes them from Royal Tunbridge Wells to Rye in East Sussex for a final showdown.
Who is the mysterious lady in the photograph and will a parrot make the journey home?
Experts Steven Moore and Angus Ashworth browse the emporiums of northeast England, parting with their big budget. But who will be victorious at the deciding auction in Dundee?
It's a new chapter as we hit the road with seasoned auctioneers James Braxton and Jonathan Pratt as they travel from Altrincham to Nantwich.
A rare glass vase and a 1960s toy head to auction showdown.

Louise Gostelow and David Harper sightsee around Northern Ireland in an old VW Beetle, on the lookout for an antique bargain. David visits the oldest distillery in the world, and Louise heads to the coast to sample some seaweed.
James Braxton and Jonathan Pratt search for bargains while traveling from Leek in Staffordshire to Birmingham.
This trip includes a hat that isn’t a hat and a dolphin in need of a dip.
Louise Gostelow and David Harper continue their adventures in Northern Ireland. David gets a shock when he gets his hands on a Victorian cure-all, while Louise finds an ally while shopping.
James Braxton and Jonathan Pratt are determined to up their game as they head from Stratford upon Avon to the auction in Frome, Somerset.
Can a tin plate toy horse trounce a pair of 19th century lusters?
It's day four of James Braxton and Jonathan Pratt's road trip as they scour local antique shops between Wells and the auction in Crewkerne.
Louise Gostelow and David Harper hit the shops in the northwest of England in their classic VW Beetle, keeping an eye out for items of interest, including some KGB spy equipment.
An enormous bird, little gnomes and two competitive experts head to auction!
James Braxton and Jonathan Pratt's fifth leg takes them from Crewkerne in Somerset to Lostwithiel in Cornwall for their final auction showdown.
Louise Gostelow and David Harper are in Wales, where Louise hopes to be sitting pretty with her collection of chairs, and David tries to step out of his comfort zone.
Natasha Raskin Sharp eyes more brooches. James’ big spend leaves him light in the pocket.
It's a brand-new week, hitting the road with David Barby and David Harper as they travel all the way from Moy to Omagh in Northern Ireland.
Creepy dolls, conjuring and cowboys feature in this final showdown at auction.

Louise Gostelow and David Harper begin their last day on the moors of West Yorkshire. Louise gets her hands on a very early labor-saving device, and David takes a shine to some theatre seats, but how many he can afford?
David Barby and David Harper grapple with Euros as they travel from Athlone to Kells in Ireland.
An Art Deco mouse takes on an unusual teapot in this new antique adventure.

Natasha Raskin Sharp splurges on an expensive French sunburst clock, and a Victorian scent bottle has her swooning. But former soldier Raj Bisram finds ammunition boxes and a steel helmet a lot more attractive.
David Barby and David Harper have crossed the North Sea to Wales--and now the competition heats up as they travel from Prestatyn to Criccieth.
Can a salt glazed Toby jug reign supreme over a brass dancing figure at auction?

Natasha Raskin Sharp and Raj Bisram continue their rally through East Anglia in the 1960s Sunbeam Rapier. Raj does a spot of 'step dancing' in a local pub, while Natasha buys a jukebox from the 1800s.
David Barby's after something quirky, while David Harper's going for the killer deal as they shop from Aberystwyth to the auction in Shrewsbury.
A Chinese ink drawing of pigs has one expert hoping to bring home the bacon.
In Kent, Raj Bisram nabs a post-Napoleonic French eagle, but cherubs and art deco costume jewelry are more Natasha Raskin Sharp's style. Which of them will clean up at the Colchester sale?
The conclusion of David Barby and David Harper's epic tour begins in Hereford--but who will be crowned king at the auction in Llanelli?
One expert needs a stroke of luck with a large handsaw and bronze boat propeller.
In Norfolk, Raj Bisram stops off at one of Britain's first nature reserves, and Natasha Raskin Sharp falls for a kitten, an owl, and takes a punt on a pair of polo horses.
Charles Hanson and David Barby kick off their journey in Lichfield, Staffordshire, and head for an auction showdown in Coventry.
Big hopes that a piece of a nearly 1000-year-old building will secure a final auction win.
It's game on as Charles Hanson and David Barby travel from Malvern to a head-to-head auction in Pewsey Wiltshire.
For their last auction in Cambridge, there's a seventies theme going on as Raj Bisram weighs in with a large set of standing scales and Natasha Raskin Sharp shells out for a lazy Susan.
It’s a vintage fairground mallet versus an Art Deco French gilded mantel clock.
Its day three for Charles Hanson and David Barby as they battle it out from Ross on Wye, Herefordshire, to Frome in Somerset for the auction.
A brand new Road Trip pairing in a 1960's classic car. Auctioneer Natasha Raskin Sharp and dealer Margie Cooper do the west of Scotland. Expect treasure hunting and curry eating.
Finds include vintage good luck charms and an Inuit stone carving.
It's all to play for as Charles Hanson and David Barby travel from Chester in Cheshire hunting antiques for the showdown in North Rode near Congleton.
Finds include a vintage artists palette, Arabic coffee pot, and a cooper plaque.
Margie Cooper and Natasha Raskin Sharp hit the antique shops of Scotland to uncover an unusual pyjama case and a rare piece of Victoriana. Both hoping for big profits at auction.
It's neck and neck between Charles Hanson and David Barby on the last leg of their journey from Stafford to Nottingham for the final showdown.
Can a fighter jet gear box help Ishy Khan win this leg of the road trip?
Margie Cooper and Natasha Raskin Sharp are antiquing in the Lake District. The battle is on for victory in the third auction, but who will come out on top?
Newcomer Margie Cooper battles it out with veteran Mark Stacey, starting the week in Chilham, Kent, and ending at auction in Heathfield, East Sussex.
Final finds include a French mantel clock and Chinese bellows.
Margie and Natasha swap their classic car for an 80 year old fire engine and a bike. With antiques in pewter, mahogany, silver and cast iron which will make the most at auction?
It couldn't be closer as Margie Cooper and Mark Stacey go hunting that antique gem, from Rochester in Kent to a showdown in Colchester in Essex.
Silver spoons and a Victorian Egyptian fob bring drama to the saleroom!
On the last leg of their trip, Margie Cooper and Natasha Raskin Sharp are darting around Derbyshire. Who will take auction glory when the gavel goes down for the final time?
Margie Cooper and Mark Stacey continue their journey, from Sawbridgeworth in Hertfordshire to an auction in Chippenham, Wiltshire.
Margie and Tim discover Tai Chi in Liverpool before their auction battle commences.
Its day four. Margie Cooper and Mark Stacey start the day in the New Forest in Hampshire ending at an auction showdown in Sherborne.
Phil Serrell and Tim Medhurst traverse the Scottish border. Both try to make a profit from militaria as they do battle at auction in Edinburgh. Plus, Phil ends up in a hedge.
